items.title: Tom Varner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 13, 2025
items.q: That guy named Bill Smith, not the clarinet player but the writer.

ctx.x: Yeah. Extreme focus on one small thing kind of. I loved – when I was – only those two years at New England Conservatory I did have a write a paper and I wrote a paper on Roscoe. And I wish I could find it. There was – oh you might have it in your archives. There was an article on Roscoe in the Canadian Coda magazine. That guy named Bill Smith, not the clarinet player but the writer. And the end of this quote from Roscoe was like he said, “I just want to make sounds that are as natural as the way these ducks over…
